what: The journeys the brief describes, as ordered steps naming the surfaces they pass through. Proposed by startups.engineer on 2026-10-20 from the memo; not yet accepted.

flows.title: A person is interviewed by Claude or ChatGPT

steps.step: The person opens the prompt page and copies the prompt
The model fetches or is given finder.json
The model asks the where question, then the stages in order, one question at a time
The model applies the rules and names the one that fired
The model writes the record from the template, in the person's words
The person keeps the record; the next interview starts from it

flows.title: A person uploads documents instead of answering

steps.step: The person gives the model a plan, a deck or notes with the prompt
The model reads them and fills the answers it can find, marked (from documents)
The model shows the answers one stage at a time and the person confirms or changes each

flows.title: A person walks the stages in the browser

steps.step: The person opens the interview page; the component loads finder.json
The person answers stage by stage; answers stay in this browser
The rules module picks the route and shows the rule
The record is written as markdown; the person copies or saves it
The person takes the record to a model with the prompt for the follow-up the page cannot do
The engineer runs release.py: fetch, bump, build, validate, test, tripwire
The commit subject carries the version; the push to dev runs the pipeline
CI validates, tags and deploys; the script polls the live version
The release history carries one sentence per release
